title: CS new grad software engineer
description: A CS new grad with two Python/Java internships evaluated against 8 postings: a new-grad program as the gap target, a junior backend role, a keyword-stuffed bootcamp sales trap, a marginal data-analyst role, and four distractors.
rationale: A 0-1 year CS new grad with Python/Java internships stresses the junior end of the seniority spectrum: most postings that share her stack are senior roles she should not be shown. j3 is the keyword trap — a commission-based bootcamp admissions sales job stuffed with the resume's exact keywords (Python, Java, Git, SQL, data structures) that TF-IDF will over-rank, but it belongs to the sales family, hence grade 0. j4 (data analyst) probes the graded boundary: genuine Python/SQL overlap at the right seniority but a different job family, hence grade 1. j5 and j8 share an engineering surface but demand 6-8+ years in different specialties, keeping them grade 0. Gap target j1 is a new-grad program whose core requirements (Python/Java, Git, SQL, testing with pytest/JUnit) the resume clearly covers, with annotated gaps limited to TypeScript/AWS (required) and Docker/React (preferred).

resume.summary: Computer science new grad with two software engineering internships building web services in Python and Java. Strong foundation in data structures, algorithms, and automated testing; looking for a backend or generalist new-grad role.

Software Engineer, New Grad — Ledgerly (Hybrid, Charlotte NC)

Ledgerly builds accounting automation for small businesses. Our new-grad program places you on a product team with a dedicated mentor from day one.

What you will do:
- Build and ship features across our Python and Java API services
- Write unit and integration tests with pytest or JUnit
- Touch the React/TypeScript frontend for full-stack tickets
- Participate in code review and the on-call shadow rotation

Requirements: Python or Java, Git, SQL, TypeScript, AWS fundamentals. 0-2 years of experience including internships; a prior software engineering internship is required. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field.

Nice to have: Docker, React, GraphQL.
